facts.fact: The Minister of ICT told Parliament in 2018 that Namibia had embarked on developing Personal Data Protection and Cyber Security Bills, so no data protection law was yet in force; the statement gives no more precise date and the document's published date (2018) is used.

note: The statement tables the Malabo Convention for ratification and says Namibia is encouraged to ratify; it states no signature or ratification, so no treaty fact.
